**vs #470 (predictor parent):** PASS. The only declared change is the model the predictor pipeline runs on (7B → 72B). **Three flagged "non-variables" verified:**

Phase 5 (a) reuses #411's already-trained adapters (NO retraining — no new condition); (b) uses the same #411-spec eval setup; (c) uses the same #470-spec predictor recipe (modulo running in the new harness's vLLM/Transformers version). The plan correctly flags that "Persona Vectors does not claim cross-scale depth invariance" — the rescale is grounded in #470's own published 7B baseline, not an external rule.
